def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(h) if all(grid[i][j]==grid[i][0] for j in range(w)) and grid[i][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==grid[0][j] for i in range(h)) and grid[0][j]!=bg]
    # block boundaries
    rb=[i for i in range(h) if i not in sep_rows]
    cb=[j for j in range(w) if j not in sep_cols]
    # group contiguous
    def groups(idx):
        g=[];cur=[idx[0]]
        for a in idx[1:]:
            if a==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(a)
            else: g.append(cur);cur=[a]
        g.append(cur);return g
    rg=groups(rb); cg=groups(cb)
    # bottom-left block
    bi=rg[-1]; bj=cg[0]
    pat=[[grid[i][j] for j in bj] for i in bi]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for gi in rg:
        for gj in cg:
            for x,i in enumerate(gi):
                for y,j in enumerate(gj):
                    out[i][j]=pat[x%len(pat)][y%len(pat)]
    return out
